scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: bash scripts/dev.sh db:up && bash -c 'cd backend && (uv run pytest -q || ./.venv/bin/pytest -q)'
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: bash -c 'cd backend && (uv run ruff check . || ./.venv/bin/ruff check .) && cd ../frontend && bun run lint'
scripts.format: bash -c 'cd backend && (uv run ruff format . || ./.venv/bin/ruff format .) && cd ../frontend && bun run lint'
scripts.migrate: bash scripts/dev.sh db:up && bash -c 'cd backend && (uv run alembic upgrade head || ./.venv/bin/alembic upgrade head)'
scripts.seed: bash scripts/dev.sh db:up && bash -c 'cd backend && (uv run python app/seed_mock_data.py || ./.venv/bin/python app/seed_mock_data.py)'
scripts.clean: find . -type d \( -name __pycache__ -o -name .pytest_cache -o -name .ruff_cache \) -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf frontend/dist
